text.content:
Another midden-choked chamber, unremarkable at a glance but clearly part of a pattern that repeats across this whole side of the floor - refuse, dumped and left, generation after generation of it.

GM Notes

Breather: No threat. This particular midden has a diver of its own.

Subquest - Midden Diving: A quick search (or simple description offer) turns up the usual junk - broken tools, a truly enormous quantity of chewed boot leather - and exactly one genuinely useful find, your choice: a serviceable trinket, a few coins, or a scrap of paper that turns out to be an earlier, cruder version of the Room 18 betting board. Play the search for comedy first; the reward is a bonus, not the point.
